title: Switching behavior and control preferences
summary: This topic groups varied comments about automatic switching behaviors, radio station changes, sport-mode lighting, charging and shutdown behavior, and a preference for physical controls, with limited clear sentiment beyond isolated praise and one complaint.

positive.summary: The positive feedback is a brief expression of overall brand affection rather than praise for a specific switching-related feature.

negative.summary: The negative feedback concerns dissatisfaction with the radio switching to a different station between trips.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention several unrelated switching or automatic behaviors, including self shutoff, incline-related shutdown context, gas-only operation, regen resetting, battery-drive switching, sport-mode lighting changes, charging starting by itself, and a preference for physical buttons, but the fragments do not clearly establish sentiment in most cases.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear attitude toward the underlying behaviors is often not observable.
The cluster mixes several unrelated subjects under the broad idea of switching, including radio behavior, drive mode behavior, lighting, charging, shutdown context, and control design.
Some fragments are short or truncated in meaning, which limits interpretation of the exact issue or user intent.
